summary: Tested WhatsApp order tracking end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (disabled->400, 401 unauth, 422 empty/invalid status, out-of-stock 400, invalid pack 400, server-side totals India 949+250=1199 / Abroad 949+700=1649, WA id format, detail edit persistence, confirm deducts Besan 750g + Poha 250g, repeat confirm/delivered no double deduction, cancel restores, unknown id 404). Frontend: admin Settings enable WhatsApp 9876543210 saved; public cart (Besan 500g + Mini Faral Box) -> popup opened to wa.me (redirects api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=919876543210) with 'Order ref: WALU50XX', items, Items 949, Delivery 250, Total 1,199; WhatsApp disabled server-side while page open -> toast 'WhatsApp orders are not available right now' and blank popup closed. Admin WhatsApp orders tab: card shows id/items/totals/status new; filter counts correct and update after status change; name/phone/note saved and persist after reload; status select confirmed persisted and stock reduced; mobile 390px no horizontal overflow. One real logic bug found: stock inflation on cancel after over-confirm.

minor.issue: Stock inflation: confirm does not check available stock and adjust_stock clamps at 0, but cancel adds back the full stock_need. Reproduced: Kadboli stock 300g, two 250g WA orders confirmed -> 50 -> 0 (clamped), both cancelled -> 500g (200g phantom stock created). Fix: either reject confirm with 400 when stock_grams < need, or store the actually-deducted grams per product on the order and restore exactly that.
Non-atomic read-then-update of stock_deducted: two concurrent status PATCHes can double deduct/restore. Use find_one_and_update with filter {id, stock_deducted: False} before adjusting stock.
Public, unauthenticated, no rate limit -> anyone can spam wa_orders collection. Consider simple IP rate limiting.
No delete endpoint for WhatsApp orders; spam/test entries can only be cancelled, not removed.

issues: Save button (wa-order-save-{id}) is very thin (~14px tall) when grid collapses to 1 column - it has px-4 but no height/py; add h-9 to match inputs
'WhatsApp orders' tab is off-screen in the horizontally scrolled tab bar with no visual hint of more tabs (minor)

action_items: Fix stock inflation in update_wa_order (validate stock on confirm or track actually-deducted amounts)
Make stock_deducted transition atomic (find_one_and_update with condition)
Add h-9 to WhatsApp order Save button for mobile layout
critical_code_review_comments: update_wa_order: confirm with insufficient stock silently clamps to 0; cancel restores full amount -> phantom stock
update_wa_order: race condition on stock_deducted flag

WhatsAppCartButton: message lines use client-side item prices rather than server lines returned by POST; fine now since quote is server-calculated, but returning lines/total from POST and using them would guarantee message == logged order

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13) + 1 logic bug found via edge test
